name: Fireball
oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} more to cast for each target beyond the first.
Fireball deals X damage divided evenly, rounded down, among any number of targets.
set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra

rulings.comment: For example, if X is 5 and you choose three target creatures, Fireball has a total cost of {7}{R} (even though its mana cost is just {5}{R} and its mana value is 6). If those creatures are all still legal targets as Fireball resolves, it deals 1 damage to each of them.
You may cast Fireball with zero targets, regardless of the value chosen for X. If you do so, it will not be a targeted spell, and no damage will actually be dealt when it resolves.
Fireball's damage is divided as Fireball resolves, not as it's cast, because there are no choices involved. The division involves only targets that are still legal as Fireball resolves.
You can target more than X creatures. However, if the number of legal targets at the time Fireball resolves is greater than X, none of them will be dealt any damage.

poprawka: Druk z arkusza kolekcji właściciela. Poprzednio snapshot i `imageUri` w katalogu niosły Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate (CLB) nr 175, id df45a43e-a5b7-4fd4-873b-7b3c021be198 — dane były składane ręcznie bez `source`, więc obraz pochodził z innego druku niż set karty (ten sam mechanizm co Curiosity/JMP ze zgłoszenia A). 2026-09-12 pobrano set-aware i potwierdzono właściwy druk: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra (JVC) nr 56, id dcbdc3be-f187-4fb2-9506-06d5abc37785.
